required_audit_coverage.name: required_audit_coverage
required_audit_coverage.detail: report covers all 35 Required Audit items with substantive aligned answers
required_audit_items: Is the execution branch exactly `agent/terminal-status-propagation-seal-restart-rework-v3`?
Is Draft PR #5 still open, unmerged, and the sole review surface targeting `main`?
Is the v6 Decision commit an ancestor of every v6 implementation, test, evidence, and final publication commit?
Is the Decision `APPROVED`, `engineering_branch`, and bound to active `reverse-agent-iteration@v2`?
Is `decision_packet.md` the task authority and `task_packet.json` background only?
Were v4 and v5 archived/sealed artifacts left read-only?
Was the v6 Decision digest locked before the final command-plan was generated and locked?
Does the final command-plan bind the exact v6 IDs, branch, Decision digest, and Decision commit?
Does the final command-plan explicitly authorize every required clean-environment, install, import, pytest, reporting, log, closeout, archive, sync, seal, staging, commit, and push command?
Are commands omitted from the final command-plan explicitly listed with evidence-backed reasons, and were they not executed?
Does Decision Preflight accept this valid `engineering_branch` round while still rejecting invalid mainlines and forbidden capabilities in tests?
Does editable install succeed under Python 3.13 in a clean temporary virtual environment outside the repository?
Does `pyproject.toml` use minimal justified metadata and avoid speculative dependencies?
Are editable-install metadata and cache paths absent from the repository dirty-state evidence through deterministic ignore or isolation policy?
Do the workflow import checks pass for `reverse_agent.project_gate`, `reverse_agent.project_state`, `reverse_agent.post_final_evidence_sync`, and `reverse_agent.decision_preflight`?
Do focused tests pass and cover every changed or newly added test file?
Does `pytest_result_summary.report_id` exactly match the canonical v6 report ID?
Does the recorded command-plan JSON stdout contain the full commands array and match the live locked command-plan?
Do recorded exit codes match the final command-plan expected exit codes?
Does execution-log contain every required command in actual observed order with current v6 IDs?
Do `codex_execution_report.md`, `execution_report.md`, auto summaries, and `report_summary_synthesis.json` agree semantically?
Does report-summary pass in a workspace equivalent to GitHub Actions, without unreported generated files?
Does final-check pass with no active FAIL/FAILED checks?
Is the v6 context packet current and generated after the current final gate?
Is the v6 state manifest current and digest-consistent with all required live artifacts?
Does the v6 round manifest exist and match the live report, pytest result, execution report, and final recommendation?
Does run-closeout execute real current-round steps after the final command-plan lock and reach a status consistent with the report?
Does the v6 final seal bind the final command-plan, report, pytest result, execution-log, final gate, closeout, context, state manifest, and round manifest?
Were all changed paths inside the authorized v6 scope, with no unexplained inherited or generated dirty files?
Were prohibited Git operations avoided?
Is final commit `S2` the PR head with no later branch mutation?
Did CI complete successfully for exact `S2`?
Did State Gate complete successfully for exact `S2`?
Did Decision Preflight complete successfully for exact `S2`?
Do report, final-check, closeout, context, state manifest, round manifest, seal, PR head, and external workflow observations agree on the final recommendation?
